note: Top navigation bar -- renders: GitLab logo, search box, 'New project', 'Issues', 'Merge requests', 'To do list', 'Help', user avatar

Project sidebar navigation -- renders: 'Project information', 'Repository', 'Issues', 'Merge requests', 'Pipelines', 'Deployments', 'Infrastructure', 'Monitor', 'Analytics', 'Wiki', 'Snippets', 'Settings'; excludes the project name header which is user-defined
SSH key warning alert -- renders: fixed warning message and 'Add SSH key' / 'Close' buttons
Auto DevOps info banner -- renders: fixed informational text and 'Learn more' / 'Close' buttons
Project title heading -- renders: project name 'byteblaze' (operator-defined project identifier in this context)
Project metadata -- renders: 'Public' visibility label and copy button
Star and Fork buttons -- renders: 'Star', 'Fork' labels and counts
Project statistics -- renders: 'Stars', 'Forks', 'Open issues', 'Merge requests' labels and counts
Repository action bar -- renders: branch selector, 'Find file', 'Web IDE', 'Clone' buttons
Repository action links -- renders: 'Commits', 'Branches', 'Tags', 'Contributors', 'Locked files', 'CI/CD', 'Security' (fixed vocabulary)
File table headers -- renders: 'Name', 'Last commit', 'Last update'
